human_required_when_submitting_observati.source_surface: Read-only UI or provider surface id from version_evidence_capture_contract.allowed_source_surfaces
human_required_when_submitting_observati.identity_binding_reference: Private token binding this capture to the same Kiosk4/A80 reader
human_required_when_submitting_observati.observed_at: ISO-8601 timestamp of the read-only observation
human_required_when_submitting_observati.evidence_reference: Private stills/screenshot receipt when visual evidence is captured
human_required_when_submitting_observati.labeled_observations[].section: Exact UI section label copied from the device screen
human_required_when_submitting_observati.labeled_observations[].field_heading: Exact field heading copied from the device screen
human_required_when_submitting_observati.labeled_observations[].value: Exact displayed version string; never the campaign planning target
